ltip_dilution_pct_source: All employees of the Company and its subsidiaries (including executive directors) will be eligible to participate in the LTIP at the discretion of the Remuneration Committee, up to a total amount of 5% of the issued share capital of the Company.
ceo_ltip_max_pct_of_salary_source: Directors salaries are set at €540,000 as at 1 January each year ... The face value of the awards, calculated as at the date of grant and based on full vesting, was €6m for the CEO... 6,000,000 / 540,000 = 11.11 = 1,111%
post_cessation_holding_years_source: Executive directors will be required to hold shares exceeding 100% of salary (or, if lower, their actual shareholding) for two years post-employment.
shareholding_requirement_ceo_source: Minimum share ownership requirements are set at three times executive director base salary.
performance_metrics: Relative TSR (total shareholder return) compared to a private equity peer group
AUM-weighted gross value creation across private equity strategies
Rolling three-year average growth in MFE
Increase in % of eligible portfolio companies with validated science-based targets
key_concerns: Long-term alignment of executive payouts to shareholder outcomes
Incorporation of ESG (e.g., diversity & decarbonisation) metrics in incentives
No annual/short-term bonus for executive directors
extraction_notes: LTIP dilution pct from specific plan limit. CEO LTIP max pct of salary calculated as €6,000,000 (face value) / €540,000 (salary) * 100 = 1,111%. Clawback/malus confirmed via policy text, as is explicit post-cessation holding period and shareholding requirement. No explicit % for CEO/employee salary increases or bonus data. ESG KPIs detailed and confirmed in performance metrics per Remuneration and Sustainability Reports. When in doubt, fields left null and explained here.
source_pdf: CVC Capital Partners Plc annual report 2024.pdf
